patientBenefits.sectionDescription: Holarc gives you a complete 360-degree view of your health profileÃ¢â‚¬â€every consultation, prescription, and clinical note from every provider, unified in one place and entirely under your control.

patientBenefits.benefit4Description: All your healthcare appointments from every provider in one calendarÃ¢â‚¬â€never miss a follow-up.

providerBenefits.sectionDescription: When patients grant you access, you see everythingÃ¢â‚¬â€their complete history across all providers. Make better decisions with better information.
